title: End-of-unit quiz: classification and habitats
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Living things and their habitats (Frozen Kingdom)
source: Seeded from science/y6 lesson 18 (End-of-unit quiz: classification and habitats (portal quiz))
intro: Covers lessons 9 to 18 of Living things and their habitats (Frozen Kingdom). Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: Which is a good feature for classifying animals?
questions.a: B) Does it have a backbone?. A backbone can be observed and has a clear yes or no answer.

questions.q: Which kingdom does yeast belong to?
questions.a: C) Fungi. Yeast is a single-celled fungus.

questions.q: A spider is an...
questions.a: B) arachnid. Spiders have eight legs and two body parts: arachnids.

questions.q: Which micro-organism makes bread rise?
questions.a: B) Yeast (a fungus). Yeast feeds on sugar and gives off carbon dioxide gas, which makes dough rise.

questions.q: Where do penguins live in the wild?
questions.a: B) Southern Hemisphere, including Antarctica. Penguins live in the Southern Hemisphere; polar bears live in the Arctic.

questions.q: In phytoplankton → krill → penguin → leopard seal, the producer is...
questions.a: B) Phytoplankton. Phytoplankton make their own food using sunlight.

questions.q: Why does an Arctic fox have small ears?
questions.a: B) To lose less heat. Small ears have less surface for heat to escape.

questions.q: Which wrapping was the best insulator in the example?
questions.a: C) Butter bag. It had the smallest temperature drop: 5 °C.

questions.q: Using the key: no feathers, lives on land. It is...
questions.a: C) Arctic fox. Question 1 no, question 3 no: Arctic fox.

questions.q: A crab is a...
questions.a: B) crustacean. Crabs are invertebrates with a hard shell: crustaceans.

questions.q: An animal with a backbone is a...
questions.a: Vertebrate

questions.q: A good sorting question has...
questions.a: A) a clear yes or no

questions.q: Is a mushroom a plant?
questions.a: No

questions.q: Linnaeus came from...
questions.a: A) Sweden

questions.q: Which kingdom is a mushroom in?
questions.a: Fungi

questions.q: Six legs and three body parts means an...
questions.a: A) insect

questions.q: All micro-organisms are harmful.
questions.a: B) false

questions.q: Yeast is a...
questions.a: Fungus

questions.q: Polar bears live in the...
questions.a: A) Arctic

questions.q: Which pole is a continent?
questions.a: Antarctic
